newsitem.title: UK: Siebe shares supported by solid first half.
newsitem.headline: Siebe shares supported by solid first half.

text.p: Shares in Siebe ticked slightly higher in pre-market trade on Tuesday after the engineering group posted first half profits towards the top end of market expectations.
One analyst described the 32 percent jump in pre-tax profits to 190.4 million stg as "a good set of figures" and the shares were reported trading two pence higher at 942 pence at 0804 GMT.
"These excellent results are very encouraging, especially since market softness was experienced in some of our sectors during the first half," said chairman Barrie Stephens.
"The board is confident of being able to deliver a further profit increase in the second half," he said in a statement.
Increased orders in the U.S. and improved conditions in the UK helped to offset a softer trading environment in continental Europe for the UK's largest diversified engineering group.
